svg.title: Command acceptance matrix of FB_CmdIf (item 5 tables) - mode Production, with Maintenance / Manual differences
svg.text: Command acceptance matrix of FB_CmdIf (item 5 tables) - mode Production, with Maintenance / Manual differences
Filled = accepted (CmdAck), empty = rejected (CmdRej + warning M*1000 + 900 + command). M = also rejected in Maintenance, X = also rejected in Manual.
Stop: from every state except Stopped, Stopping, Aborting, Aborted, Clearing. Abort: from every state except Aborting, Aborted. Others: only along an edge of the item 5 state model.
Aborting accepts no command at all. Maintenance removes Suspend/Unsuspend; Manual allows only Reset, Start, Stop, Abort, Clear.
